label: Start (Heute)
navNotes: Home is not a nav.ts area; it is the APP_HOME target of the logo/'Start' tab in the phone bar and the sidebar header.

redesign.research: Linear 'My issues' + Inbox (what is assigned to me, what needs me), Notion Home (recently visited, upcoming), Shopify Home ('Things to do': orders to fulfil, payments to capture — counts that link to filtered lists). All: personal first, counts that link to the filtered work, no dashboards of everything.
redesign.job: What needs me now: my shift to clock into, my tasks, things waiting for me, what's on today.
redesign.phone: Top bar Start. 'Jetzt' card first when the person is on the shift team (clock in/out of the current shift or the next one; same logic as Schichten › Meine). 'Wartet auf dich': rows with AreaIcon · label · count › (overdue/today tasks, hours to approve, new form submissions, orders to send, overdue invoices, overdue dues, unread notifications) — only for modules on and permitted, hidden when 0; all clear → one line. 'Meine Aufgaben' (due first, tap = task panel). 'Heute' / next events. 'Schnell' chips (Neuer Kontakt, Ticket scannen …). Sprout ask box last.
redesign.desktop: Two columns from lg: left Jetzt + Wartet auf dich + Meine Aufgaben, right Heute (events + my shifts) + Schnell + Benachrichtigungen.
moves: header SunIcon + 'Heute' + meta → area-less header: title 'Start' in the top bar, meta org · date kept
Sprout ask box → kept, below 'Für dich'
Meine Aufgaben → kept (rows open ?task=), overdue in red
Meine nächsten Schichten (all → /shifts/me) → Jetzt card (clock in/out) + next shifts rows (link /shifts/me)
Nächste Veranstaltungen → 'Heute & demnächst', rows open the event
Überfällige Beiträge card → row in 'Wartet auf dich' → /members/dues?status=overdue
Benachrichtigungen card → row 'Ungelesen' in 'Wartet auf dich' + latest 3 rows
Alle links → rows themselves link to the filtered list
new: quick action chips (same list as search's Schnellaktionen)

sweep.note: Wartet auf dich: a count pill repeated the number already in the label ('3 Aufgaben fällig  3'): removed, overdue rows in red. Task rows linked to '/?task=' which is the website on the bare domain: now /app?task=. Checked Jetzt card, my tasks, Sprout box, events, shifts, quick actions, notifications.

pages.title: Heute
pages.purpose: What needs this person now: Sprout question box, own open tasks, next shifts, next events, overdue dues, unread notifications.
pages.permission: signed-in member; cards depend on module + permission

urlState.meaning: task id → TaskDrawer (projects) opens over Home

sections.title: Sprout ask box
sections.notes: Three idea chips: „Was steht heute an?“, „Welche Aufgaben sind überfällig?“, „Hilf mir, ein Event anzulegen“ (sprout.ideas.*) send a preset question; opens the Sprout panel with a new chat (window event 'sprout:ask').

sections.title: Meine Aufgaben
sections.notes: projects + projects.view; 6 open tasks assigned to me, due date (red when overdue); row → /?task=<id>; 'Alle' → /projects/tasks?assignee=me&view=list; empty 'Keine offenen Aufgaben für dich.'

sections.title: Meine nächsten Schichten
sections.notes: shifts + shifts.self and a staff record; 4 upcoming assigned shifts; rows → /shifts/me; empty 'Keine Schichten geplant.'

sections.title: Nächste Veranstaltungen
sections.notes: events + events.view; 4 upcoming (not cancelled), draft badge; row → /events/<id>; 'Alle' → /events

sections.title: Überfällige Beiträge
sections.notes: members + members.view; red sum + count of open dues past due; 'Alle' → /members/dues; 'Nichts überfällig.'

overlays.title: <task>
overlays.notes: same task panel as in Projekte

pages.phone: Cards stack in one column; Sprout box first.
uxNotes: Shift rows all link to /shifts/me, not to the shift itself (no deep link).
Overdue dues 'Alle' goes to /members/dues without an overdue filter.
Card 'Alle' links use FormCard action slots; no primary action on the home page, so the phone + button is absent here.
Opening a notification from Home may switch the active org (see notifications).
